class.name: GaeaGenerationPriority
class.brief_description: Calculates priority [member level] based on distance of [member area] from [member origin].
class.description: Treats the distance between [member area]'s position and the [member origin] position as a priority axis. The closer the given area is to the player for example, the higher its priority. Useful for chunk generation.

method.name: create
method.description: Creates a new [b]GaeaGenerationPriority[/b] object with an [param origin] and an [param area].

members.member: The area to measure distance off of. The position is calculated using [member AABB.position] / [member AABB.size].
The origin to measure distance off of.
